# Noto Emoji source

Upstream: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji

Distribution source: Google Fonts `ofl/notoemoji/NotoEmoji[wght].ttf`.
Positron fixes the variable font at weight 400 and emits a renamed static
TrueType subset through `scripts/build_fonts.py`.
